text:
Palladium Price in 1994
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1994, the LBMA palladium price rose 26.3% between 1994-01-31 ($125) and 1994-12-29 ($157). The highest sampled price was $159 in October and the lowest was $125 in January. The mean of these observations was $144. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
